diagnostics: MegatronPolicyWorker uses Ray physical GPU 1 as CUDA ordinal 1 under CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1; only ordinal 0 is visible.
Independent NeMo placement groups choose engine slot zero and race for vLLM rendezvous port 7000.
fixes: Resolve CUDA ordinal from Ray allocation and inherited CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES before set_device; retain physical ID for NUMA.
Acquire node-local per-user file lock over a free 100-port vLLM window for single-GPU actor lifetime before vLLM environment caching.
Apply editable NeMo source hooks through --nemo-only without reinstalling any backend or rebuilding CUDA extensions.

tests.real_concurrency: Six independent processes choose disjoint windows before binding real PyTorch TCPStore servers concurrently.
tests.source_integration: Execute actual patched worker startup AST; reproduce CUDA mask and capture physical NUMA binding.
tests.reproducibility: Recreate patched vendor files from pinned Git HEAD, apply twice, byte-compare and parse all patched files.

limitations: Tests use CPU TCPStore and a CUDA selection stub, not the B200 CUDA training stack.
File locks coordinate DFlash jobs sharing UID and temporary directory on the same node; unrelated programs do not honor those locks.
